sam_sales: FYI we have a signed LOI with MediCore for a 90-day POC. They want a clear capacity plan that balances cost and p99 latency guarantees. SE/Infra/Security — can we sketch an executable POC plan?

elaine_se: Summary from MediCore: median payload ~120 tokens, typical session 3 turns, baseline traffic ~400 RPS, but marketing demos spike to 4k RPS for ~60-120s. SLA ask: p99 <600ms for generation. They also want quantization options evaluated for cost.

chris_infra: Recommended baseline: reserved 4 GPUs (A100 equivalent) to cover baseline and steady-state, with autoscale min=1 max=12, scale step=2, cooldown=25s. Add burst credits to absorb demo spikes. For quantization testing, run one quantized variant (8-bit) behind canary routing.

sam_sales: MediCore asked for quick numbers: cost delta for 4-reserved vs fully on-demand for a 30-day POC with burst. Who can give a ballpark?

kevin_fin: Ballpark: 4-reserved monthly commit is ~28% cheaper than on-demand for the same GPU-hours. For a 30-day POC, offer a POC bundle: 150 GPU-hours reserved credit + 50k burst token credits. If they convert, we roll POC credit into first invoice.

mona_sec: Questionnaire highlights: BYOK, VPC or private link, encryption at rest/in transit, and a short attestation on PHI handling. Also need to know retention windows and whether logs can be disabled.

chris_infra: We support BYOK/KMS, VPC peering, and can enable no-persistent-logs. Retention configurable 7/30/90/365 days. For PHI we can enable automatic redaction and provide an attestation paragraph.

elaine_se: POC test plan (concise):
- Day 0: baseline deploy, reserve 4 GPUs, enable canary quantized model route
- Day 1: 2h ramp to 80% baseline (320 RPS)
- Day 2: Three demo spikes to 4k RPS for 60-120s to validate burst credits and autoscale fallbacks
- Continuous: monitor p95/p99, tokens/sec, queue depth, and model OOMs
- End: cost vs quality eval comparing full vs quantized outputs

chris_infra: Prewarm command for POC:
```
redwoodctl prewarm --namespace medicore --prompts-file top20_demo.json --duration 1800 --parallel 6
```
This preloads KV and warms weights. Schedule 20-30m before demo windows.

mona_sec: For the security questionnaire I need one-line answers I can drop in. Chris?

chris_infra: One-liners: "KMS: BYOK supported (customer-managed keys)", "Private link/VPC peering: supported for Dedicated/Private", "Retention: configurable (7/30/90/365 days)", "Logs: no-persistent-logs mode available", "PHI: automatic redaction optional; attestation available".

kevin_fin: I'll prepare a POC quote: reserved vs on-demand delta + burst addon + optional extra 4 GPUs on-demand for day-of demos (billed separately). Will post numbers within 12h.

elaine_se: Fallback strategy if autoscale lags: 1) route to quantized variant, 2) shorten max context length, 3) apply queue cap with informative 429 and Retry-After. Add to runbook.

sam_sales: Can infra add an ops checklist for the buyer? Short bullets I can paste into the SOW.

chris_infra: Ops checklist:
- Reserve 4 GPUs in medicore namespace
- Configure autoscale min=1 max=12 step=2 cooldown=25s
- Provision 50k burst token credits + option to add 4 on-demand GPUs for demos
- Upload top20_demo prompts file and schedule prewarm 30m prior to demos
- Enable per-route tracing and token-cost export
- Configure VPC peering and BYOK KMS; provide KMS setup doc
- Set fallback: quantized route + short-context fallback + queue cap

mona_sec: Legal wants a short statement: "Redwood can be configured to not persist raw prompts; PHI redaction available and we will provide SOC2 artifacts on request." Chris to confirm.

chris_infra: Confirmed. We'll provide SOC2 summary and a short PHI attestation paragraph.

ci-bot: Prewarm job scheduled: prewarm-medicore-2800001234 queued. Will report start/finish.

sam_sales: Great. I'll send this to MediCore after Kevin posts the POC quote. Thanks team :rocket:
